dct_description_sm:
This is a repository to collect the data and analysis/plotting files for the broad-tunable three-wave-mixing research conducted at the University of Alberta by Benjamin D. Smith, Bahar Babaei, Andal Narayanan, and Lindsay LeBlanc.

Most of these data were collected using a Rohde & Schwartz spectrum analyzer, although some were collected with a vector network analyzer and an oscilloscope, as indicated in the manuscript. The data analysis was conducted primarily in python.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Microwave-to-optical conversion in a room-temperature 87Rb vapor with frequency-division multiplexing control
